summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for applying @trace decorator to workflow functions for observability. It differs semantically from existing skills: not about reward function signatures, dataset filtering, or other instrumentation patterns. Peer candidates (Agent Task Execution with @operation, Initialize AgentOps Session, End AgentOps Trace) are related but address different instrumentation layers (@operation wrapping, session initialization, session closure). This skill is orthogonal—it decorates individual workflow functions with trace metadata. No existing skill covers @trace decorator application with name/tags parameters. Support evidence from Debugging Roadmap confirms the pattern is documented and valid.
